description.name: Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning]/[Attach Dark] after using a Lightning/Dark ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ravus
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Technique - Last Rites (0~2), removed after using Technique - Last Rites two times

description.name: Technique - Last Rites Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Technique - Last Rites level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ravus]

description.name: Technique - Last Rites Level
description.text: Keeps track of Technique - Last Rites level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ravus]
